description: This file provides high-level API definitions for the Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) feature within the Realtek RTL8367/RTL8367C switch driver. It includes function prototypes for initializing EEE, enabling/disabling EEE per port, and querying port EEE status.

methods.name: rtk_eee_init
methods.description: Initializes the Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) feature in the switch driver.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables EEE on a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current EEE enable status of a specific port.
